description: This file defines the 'ViewQuickcreate' class which extends 'ViewAjax' to handle the quick create view in SuiteCRM, including pre-display setup, view rendering logic, and integration with template files and other views.

classes.name: ViewQuickcreate
classes.description: Handles rendering of the quick create popup form within SuiteCRM, managing view setup, template assignments, and dynamic inclusion of module-specific view classes.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the view before display, loading the source bean if applicable and setting internal flags.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the quick create view, determining the appropriate view definitions, setting up the edit view object, and invoking display logic.

methods.name: getEditView
methods.description: Creates and returns a new 'EditView' object.
